notes.title: Due to plot requirements, the game will be delayed until late July for release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone~
The process of making a game always involves delaying the release (no it doesnt) and making announcements. Therefore, for the sake of teaching and the story of game, it was decided to delay the release of the game for a month, so as to record the video footage of how to delay the release of the game and make an announcement in game's Chapter 10. 
Thank you for waiting! 
Hug~
